p.i: peratorium,à serenisss.recordationis Pr. in-victisss.D.Ferdinādo,Rom.Imp. itidem aug. in templo aulæ Oenipontanæ contiguo,quod lingua vernacula,

vocant, splēdidissimè & magnificentissimè exstru-ctum, huc relatū literatenus inserereremus: Quia & hoc ipsius Majest.decantatiora & magis illustria facta, elegantissimo & ca-lo & calamo effigiata,complectitur. Extat autē in templo istius medio,ferreis clathris, satis artificiosis, & velis suis cōtra injurias circumdatum : quibus remotis apparent ad caput & pedes, & ex utroq; latere 24. tabellæ, de purissimo & candidissimo marmore, opere elevato seu anaglyptico scitis-simè & saberrimè exsculpta, nigroq; non minus splendicanti suis spaciis inserta: quæ prætacta ipsius Majestatis illustriora, & nunquam intermoritura facinora,summo artificio expressa,gratissimo spectaculo visenda exhibent. Historia verò singula scriptura suà aureis literis nigricanti marmo-ri graphicè incisis subtus compendiosè ex-plicantur : quas antequam recenseamus, Inscri-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "splendicanti" (the printed word at the line end is hard to make out, [?] advisable); "saberrimè" likely "faberrimè" in print, the letter is unclear; "circumdatum" is followed by a dash-like mark, possibly a stop or a pointer; "inserereremus" may be a printing error for "inserueremus" (left as printed); "Inscri-" is the last line and continues on the next page. "Pr. in-victisss" is printed with a long s followed by an f-like form; read as "invictissimi" would be a normalisation and is not applied. The black letter "den neuen Bau" is set in Gothic type within italic text. The page has no catchword or signature.
